reps.title: Repetitions
reps.basis: Recounted on the server from the stored thigh and shank frames.
reps.notCountable: Cannot recount: too few paired frames ({pairs}).
reps.noExcursion: No movement reached the repetition start threshold.
reps.deviceMissing: No count from the patient's device was saved.
reps.deviceSame: Matches the count on the patient's device.
reps.windowEmpty: Cannot recount: none of the saved windows the count was zeroed on holds paired thigh and shank frames. The stored pairs are drawn grey on the chart.
reps.cancelled: Not counted because the data paused for longer than {ms} ms mid-repetition: {n}.
reps.sinceLastStart: The recount starts at the last press of Start, as the count on the device does. Paired frames before it: {n}; they are grey on the chart.
reps.zeroFromFirstFrames: The window the count was zeroed on was not saved, so the recount is zeroed on the first 0.5 s of stored frames.
reps.restarted: The patient's page reloaded during the session, and the count on the device started again.
reps.beforeFirstStart: Paired frames before the first saved press of Start: {n}. They are not recounted; they are grey on the chart.
reps.perStartTitle: Sum over the presses of Start, each recounted from its own zero:
reps.perStartNoZero: Press {i} ({time}): not recounted, the zero window holds no stored frames
reps.perStartTooFew: Press {i} ({time}): too few paired frames to count ({pairs})
reps.deviceLastStartOnly: Counted on the patient's device: {n}. That count covers only the last press of Start, so it is not compared with the sum.

chart.title: Sensor signal
chart.yAxis: Y axis: change in the shank-minus-thigh pitch difference from the resting pose the count was zeroed on, bend direction positive, °
chart.xAxis: Time from the start of the chart, s
chart.caption: This is not knee flexion: the sensors are not calibrated, and the value is not used for any score.
chart.downsampled: Showing {shown} of {total} points; each time slice keeps its minimum and maximum.
chart.empty: There are no paired thigh and shank frames, so there is nothing to plot.
chart.aria: Relative sensor orientation chart: {points} points, counted repetitions shaded: {reps}
chart.legendBeforeStart: Grey dashed line: frames before the first press of Start, not recounted
chart.legendNoZero: Some grey frames are drawn from their own first 0.5 s: the window the count was zeroed on holds no stored frames, so they are not recounted
chart.legendStarts: Vertical dashed line: a press of Start; each press has its own zero

tech.title: Technical details
tech.ratePending: Setup had not finished when the session started

rateFailure.write_failed: the command could not be written

tech.hzBasis: Rates use the browser's receive time of each frame, so they include Bluetooth delays and gaps.
tech.footHzUnavailable: For the foot the result carries only a frame count, not frame times, so its rate cannot be computed.
tech.pendingAtFinish: Frames unsent at the end of the session
tech.deviceAtStart: At the start of the session: {device}
tech.fromStart: as recorded at the start of the session
tech.batteryBasis: Voltage is read from the sensor's register 0x64. The percentage comes from WitMotion's table, not a measured charge. “unknown” means the read failed or was not saved.
tech.reconnectsBasis: Reconnects: how many times the link to the same sensor came back since it was connected.
tech.maxGap: Pause in the data that discards a repetition in progress
tech.telemetryBasis: Confirmed, unsent and dropped frames and send errors are the patient's device's own counts at finish. Frames sent later are not included; the first table shows how many frames are actually stored.
tech.skewTitle: Skew between sensors by receive time
tech.skewBasis: For every stored shank frame, the time to the thigh frame received nearest to it, with no cap. Receive times are the browser's, so they include Bluetooth delays. Thigh and shank only: for the foot the result carries a frame count without frame times.
tech.pairingTitle: Thigh and shank pairs for the recount
tech.pairingBasis: A shank frame is paired with the nearest thigh frame only when they are at most {ms} ms apart, so skew within pairs is never more than {ms} ms. This is the recount's pairing tolerance, not the skew between sensors, which the block above shows.

exercise.interruptedBody: The app is trying to reconnect the sensor on its own. If that doesn't work, connect it with the button in that sensor's row. Repetitions aren't counted while the thigh or shin sends no data; counting then continues from the same starting position.

saving.title: Recording
saving.errors: Sending errors: {n}. Records that didn't go through are kept on this device, and the app keeps trying to send them while it's open.
saving.dropped: Not saved because the internet was down for too long: {n}.
saving.finishingPending: Sending the remaining records: {n}. This takes up to 10 seconds; anything left over the app sends later, while it's open.

exercise.finishFailed: Couldn't finish the session. Check your internet connection and try again.
exercise.checkingSession: Checking that the session is still in progress…
exercise.restarted: This session was already recording earlier, for example before the page reloaded, so the count on this screen started again from zero. Repetitions you did before that stay with the session and will be recounted for your care team. Don't repeat them: do only the remaining ones, then press “Finish early”.

pause.thigh: Counting paused: no data from the thigh sensor.
pause.shank: Counting paused: no data from the shin sensor.
pause.both: Counting paused: no data from the thigh and shin sensors.

exercise.footMissing: The foot sensor isn't sending data, so its records aren't being saved right now. Counting continues: it uses the thigh and shin sensors.
exercise.restartedFullSet: This session was already recording earlier, for example before the page reloaded, so the count on this screen started again from zero. Records saved before that stay with the session, but the repetitions in them may not be counted. So do the whole set again, from the first repetition.
